analysis:
The only change in docs/architecture/inference.md is at head lines 2964-2970, a documentation edit. It states that the control leader's cluster service re-plans and re-adopts the same model after a Darkbloom update only once both Macs report the same worker build (`ClusterOnboardingUpdate.oneBuild`). It links to the pair's coordinated update, which restarts the two Macs seconds apart, and notes that a plan made while one Mac still runs the other build would fail and wait 600 s. The patch touches no code, configuration, keys, trust boundaries or authorization paths.

The edit describes an availability and consistency precondition for re-plan. That is consistent with the existing statement that both workers bind their lane count in the load agreement and refuse a disagreement before serving (head lines 3120-3122). It also fits the 'same runtime block' requirement on cluster plans (lines 2894-2899). It does not weaken peer authentication, the owner-authenticated control channel or the encrypted data plane.

The oneBuild gate, ClusterOnboardingUpdate and the coordinated-update behaviour are source code outside the supplied evidence, so I could not verify them. The documented 600 s wait is a bounded liveness behaviour, not a new attack surface in the supplied text. The relevant threat boundaries (TB-011, TB-007 and the cluster scope) are unchanged. No threat-model update is needed from this edit alone. The remainder of the file (lines 2841-3587) is unchanged context. I found nothing that bears on T-041 or the other listed threats.
